title: Honeyed Filipino Jam Custard
description: A jammy, pillowy custard with a caramelized honey glaze, inspired by Filipino leche flan and flambe techniques.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a 9-inch round cake pan with butter.
In a bowl, whisk together all purpose flour, granulated sugar, salt, and vanilla powder until evenly mixed.
Add eggs one at a time, whisking well after each, then pour in coconut milk and stir until the batter is smooth.
Pour the custard batter into the prepared pan and cover loosely with foil.
Bake for 35 minutes, then remove the foil and drizzle the honey evenly over the custard surface.
Light the honey with a long match to create a caramelized glaze while it bubbles, making sure the flame does not engulf the sauce.
Return the pan to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes until the top turns golden brown and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Cool the custard to room temperature, then refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.
